summary: American Express Receivables Financing Corporation III LLC, as transferor, and American Express National Bank, as sponsor, disclosed a September 15, 2026 Underwriting Agreement with Barclays, Mizuho, RBC and Scotiabank for the American Express Credit Account Master Trust's Series 2026-1 issuance. The Trust will sell Class A 4.99% Asset Backed Certificates to public underwriters, while Class B 5.39% certificates are placed directly with the transferor or affiliate. Closing is expected on or about September 22, 2026, alongside a Series 2026-1 Supplement to the Pooling and Servicing Agreement. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
